jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
🧠💻 Fullstack Developers Who Like Variety. Oslo Needs You!

Still working on the same codebase, the same stack and the same problems?
Yeah. We thought you might be ready for something different.

We’re looking for experienced .NET / Fullstack Developers in Oslo who enjoy solving interesting problems, learning new technology and having the freedom to shape how they work.

If you’re strongest on the backend but comfortable across the stack, enjoy clean code and like being around people who genuinely care about technology, keep scrolling 👇

🔥 What You’ll Actually Work With

There’s no “this is your stack forever” mentality here.

Depending on your interests and the projects you get involved with, you could be working with:

Backend
.NET / C#
Modern .NET frameworks
APIs and distributed systems
Cloud-based backend architecture

Frontend
React
Angular
Vue
Modern JavaScript / TypeScript

Cloud & Architecture
Azure
AWS
Cloud-native architecture
Microservices
CI/CD and modern development practices

You don’t need to know everything.
What matters more is that you enjoy learning, experimenting and getting better at what you do.

🧩 What Kind of Developer Fits Here?
5+ years of professional development experience
Strong .NET / C# background
Comfortable working across backend and frontend
You care about clean, maintainable code
You enjoy learning new technologies
You like solving problems rather than simply completing tickets
You’re interested in architecture, cloud and modern development
Norwegian at B2 level or higher 🇳🇴

Senior developers with broad experience will feel especially at home.

🚀 Build Your Career Without Being Put in a Box

Your career doesn’t have to follow one predefined path.

You can go deeper technically, move towards architecture, take on technical leadership, or explore people leadership.

The important thing is that your development follows your interests and strengths.

🤝 Work With People Who Actually Care About Engineering

You’ll be surrounded by experienced developers who enjoy sharing knowledge and challenging each other technically.

Expect:
Strong focus on code quality
Test-driven development and good engineering practices
Technical discussions that go beyond “it works”
Knowledge sharing and continuous learning
Support for certifications and professional development
A lot of freedom and flexibility in how you work

And if you discover a new technology you want to get really good at, there’s room to pursue it.

💡 The Projects

You could find yourself working on everything from modernising existing platforms to building new digital products and services.

The technology is used across areas including:
Energy
Finance
Telecommunications
Retail
Insurance
Other large-scale digital services

That means plenty of variety, different technical challenges and the chance to see how your work actually gets used.

💰 The Practical Stuff

Competitive salary
Strong benefits package
Support for certifications and training
Flexible working
Good work-life balance
A strong technical community
Plenty of opportunities to influence your own career

👀 Sound Like You?

If you’re a .NET developer who wants more variety, more freedom and the chance to keep learning rather than getting stuck in the same technology for years, this could be worth a conversation.

Apply, send me a message, or just reach out for an informal chat. 🚀

jobs.title: Engineering Manager – Digital Customer Platforms
jobs.description:
Make a difference with Laerdal where immersive technology transforms healthcare quality and education across the globe. With over 2,200 colleagues, join a team where collaboration and engagement are prioritized in helping save one million more lives, every year, by 2030.

About the role

In the Digital Customer Platforms team at Laerdal, we shape how customers around the world discover, buy, and use products and services that help save lives. Through our global e‑commerce platform on laerdal.com, we deliver scalable, secure, and increasingly AI‑supported digital solutions across more than 25 markets.
As Engineering Manager, based in Stavanger, you will lead a great team of software engineers working on business‑critical platforms with real societal impact. You’ll balance people leadership with technical insight, creating an environment where collaboration, learning, and long‑term product sustainability come first. Your role is to help teams succeed—today and over time—while continuously improving how we build and evolve our digital solutions.
Our technology landscape is modern and evolving, with C#/.NET on Azure at the core and React and Vue.js on the frontend. Experience with our stack is valuable, but we especially welcome leaders with strong fundamentals in cloud technologies, APIs, and product‑focused software development, who are curious about how AI can be applied responsibly and meaningfully.

Some of what you will be doing

Lead and support a team of engineers by setting clear direction, building trust, and encouraging growth
Shape technical choices with an eye on quality, sustainability, security, and long‑term platform health
Partner closely with Product and Design to turn ideas into well‑prioritized, valuable customer solutions
Strengthen ways of working across the team—from planning and delivery to testing and continuous improvement
Promote good engineering practices and thoughtful use of emerging technologies, including AI

Help create a positive, inclusive team culture where diverse perspectives are valued

Who we think will thrive here

You are a leader who enjoys enabling others and believes strong teams build the best products. You bring technical credibility, curiosity, and empathy to your work, and you’re motivated by creating durable solutions rather than quick fixes. Whether you already lead teams or are ready to take the next step into engineering leadership, you care deeply about collaboration, quality, and impact.

Experience that will support your success includes:
A solid background in software development and modern engineering practices and relevant higher education
Experience leading, mentoring, or guiding engineers in a product‑focused environment
Comfort working with cloud‑based systems; Azure experience is a plus
Experience from agile, empowered, cross‑functional teams
A leadership style that communicates clearly, listens actively, and builds engagement
Takes initiatives and move ideas into action
Approaches challenges with structured problem solving and critical thinking. .

We know strong leaders don’t all look the same—if this role speaks to you, we’d love to hear from you.

What we offer

At Laerdal, you will get the opportunity to learn, develop, and innovate and you will be a part of an international working environment where the possibility to make an impact is endless.
An interesting, impactful and important job contributing to our mission
Great opportunities for growth and personal development
A multicultural office environment and collaboration with colleagues located around the world
A creative, diverse, and inclusive organization
A job in a company driving forward-thinking technology
Competitive salary, pension scheme, and insurance
An extensive welfare program with company benefits such as discounted public transport, indoor bicycle garage, and workshop, wardrobe with towel service, social and sports groups, company cabins, and more

Our colleagues are from all over the world, and we pride ourselves on being an international company. We offer a competitive relocation package if you will be relocating from another country to Norway.

Curious to know more? Please contact Katrine Holdhus; katrine.holdhus@laerdal.com for questions regarding this vacancy.

Don’t wait until the deadline (14 October) to apply. We review applications as they come in and may begin interviews before the closing date.

Please note that we use Semac background checks in our recruitment process.

Department:
Software development
Type:
Full-time

October 13, 2026

Are you ready to build the software that helps medical professionals harness the power of AI? Aiforia is transforming the world of tissue diagnostics and medical image analysis. We equip pathologists and scientists with deep learning AI to improve efficiency and consistency across clinical histopathology of cancer.

Our mission is to provide high-quality, AI-assisted solutions that enable personalized and democratized care for patients. To help us achieve this, we are looking for a driven Software Engineer to build and improve the products that bring our AI to clinical and research users.

Role and responsibilities

As a core member of our engineering team, you will work across the full stack, from back-end services to the web applications our customers use every day. You will help expand Aiforia's platform and keep our existing products robust and reliable.

Your key tasks will include:

Architecture and design: Design scalable, robust solutions across the stack, from back-end services and APIs to user-facing web features.
Software implementation: Develop, write, and optimize production-level code across the stack.
AI tooling and context: Write and maintain the specifications, repository context, and prompts that make AI workflows possible.
Quality assurance: Ensure high standards of code quality and reliability through code reviews, unit tests, and validation protocols.
Technical documentation: Write and maintain clear, accurate technical documentation to support development, regulatory compliance, and cross-team collaboration.
Product maintenance: Monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain existing products to ensure seamless performance for our users in clinical and research settings.

Who we are looking for

The ideal candidate is a versatila engineer who is comfortable moving between back-end front-end work. You write clean dove, care about the end user, and thrive in a collaborative, mission-driven environment.

Requirements:

Educational background: BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Engineering, or a closely related field.
Experience: 3+ years of relevant industry experience in full-stack or software engineering.
Technical skills: Strong programming skills and hands-on experience building and deploying web applications and back-end services in production.
Communication: Excellent teamwork and communication skills. Fluency in written and spoken English is a must.
AI-assisted development: Daily hands-on use of AI coding tools in production work. You can explain the role of agents and context in the development workflow, and how you verify the result.

What gives you an edge:

Experience and knowledge of image analysis and AI model building, and the workflows associated with them, including data management, verification metrics, and validation.
Experience building and evolving an AI harness: the infrastructure around the development process that lets agents operate as independent actors across the delivery lifecycle.
Experience improving how a team adopts AI coding tools: shared context, execution loops, and safety boundaries.
Experience with our core stack: C#/.NET.
Experience with modern front-end frameworks (e.g. React, Angular, TypeScript).
Familiarity with REST APIs, databases, and cloud computing platforms.
Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, and DevOps practices.
Previous experience working with medical devices, healthcare data, or within regulated environments (e.g. ISO 13485, FDA).

What we offer

Innovation: A chance to work at the forefront of medical AI technologies and make a real impact on patient care.
Culture: Join a supportive, enthusiastic, and multidisciplinary team of experts who are passionate about what they do.
Growth: Real opportunities for professional and career development in one of the fastest-growing sectors of health tech.

Location

Helsinki, Finland. We offer a hybrid work model that provides flexibility for your daily life. However, we hope that you will work primarily from our office during the initial stage of your employment. This ensures you receive the best possible support, a smooth onboarding experience, and the opportunity to truly get to know your team from day one.

Please note: We are unable to sponsor visas for this position.

How to apply

Are you the person we are looking for? Please, send your application by October 13, 2026 through careers.aiforia.com.
For data privacy reasons, we only accept applications submitted via the portal.
Please include a portfolio or work samples showcasing your design process and past projects.
Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis prior to the deadline, so please submit yours as soon as possible.

Before you apply: Please read Aiforia's Privacy Policy for Job Applicants before submitting your application.

Aiforia is committed to creating an environment of inclusivity in which all voices and individuals are heard. We strive toward this by providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, citizenship status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status and to affirmatively seek to advance the principles of equal employment opportunity.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

We are looking for a Software Engineering Specialist to contribute to the development of clinical application software for patient monitoring products.

In this software engineering role, you will work as part of a multi-disciplinary agile team developing software that helps clinicians monitor patients and make timely care decisions. The work includes designing, implementing, testing, and maintaining application software for patient monitors, including visualization of physiological measurements, alarms, trends, statuses, graphics, and reliable data transfer within the system and to external networks.

You will learn and apply modern software engineering practices in a regulated medical device environment, with support from experienced engineers and the wider team. The role includes responsible use of Generative AI tools as part of the software development workflow to support productivity, learning, code quality, testing, documentation, and everyday engineering work.

This is a great opportunity for an early-career software engineer who is curious, collaborative, quality-minded, and eager to grow in health technology.

Responsibilities

Job Description

Design, implement, test, and maintain clinical application software for patient monitoring products as part of an agile software development team.
Develop software features related to visualization of medical measurements, including numbers, waveforms, statuses, trends, graphics, alarms, and measurement data transfer within the system and to external networks.
Contribute to feature development under the guidance of more experienced engineers, gradually building technical ownership of defined tasks and smaller feature areas.
Apply modern software engineering methods, tools, and practices to develop robust, maintainable, and high-quality software that meets the expectations of the medical device industry.
Participate actively in design reviews, code reviews, testing, defect analysis, and required documentation.
Write and maintain unit tests and other automated tests and contribute to improving testability and software quality.
Use AI coding assistants responsibly as part of daily software engineering work, for example in ticket investigation, code generation, test creation, documentation, refactoring, debugging, and learning, in accordance with company policies.
Work as an active member of a collaborative, multi-disciplinary agile team, contributing to shared goals and continuous improvement.
Collaborate with software engineers, testers, clinical experts, system engineers, and other stakeholders in a cross-functional, multi-cultural, and global environment.
Continuously build technical skills, product understanding, and knowledge of software development in a regulated healthcare environment.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or an equivalent field.
Hands-on experience or solid academic/project background in object-oriented software design and development, preferably with C++.
Basic understanding of modern software development practices, agile ways of working, and software quality activities such as reviews, testing, and documentation.
Experience or interest in application software, user interface development, embedded software, or software platforms.
Willingness to learn and use AI coding assistants responsibly as part of everyday software development work.
Demonstrated engineering curiosity, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
Self-starter attitude—eager and quick to learn, experiment, ask questions, and grow.
Ability and willingness to work collaboratively with team members to achieve shared goals.
Growth mindset with commitment to continuous learning and improvement.
Fluency in English, both spoken and written.
Legally authorized to work in Finland.

Desired Qualifications

Experience or coursework related to technologies used in medical or embedded software systems, such as Linux, RTOS, Qt/QML, embedded systems, configuration management, continuous integration, test automation, or Python.
Experience with user interface development, especially Qt/QML.
Basic understanding of multithreaded programming or interest in learning concurrency concepts.
Experience working with a larger code base through studies, internships, thesis work, open-source projects, or professional experience.
Interest in physiological measurements, clinical workflows, patient monitoring, or healthcare technology.
Interest in software development for safety-critical, regulated, or high-quality product environments.

We offer

Work for a great purpose—your work will help improve patient care and save lives.
A unique opportunity to learn and develop leading-edge health technologies and products.
Supportive colleagues and a team with great spirit.
Opportunity to learn from talented experts in the health technology industry.
Access to world-class processes, tools, and professionals across different functions.
A diverse, multi-cultural working environment where you can contribute and grow.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
Regular technical and soft skills learning opportunities to build your knowledge and skills.
Possibility to grow your skills and abilities to support future roles in the organization, including technical and managerial career paths.
Flexible working hours in a hybrid mode, combining remote work and office work.
Office near Pasila railway station in central Helsinki with own on-site parking, gym, café, and restaurant.

Interested?

For further information, please contact Software Engineering Manager Pauli Salokoski (pauli.salokoski(at)gehealthcare.com, +358-50-586 5686).

Additional Information

No

Do you want to create new networking products and craft clean APIs that enable customers to better use the Akamai Cloud?

Are you a software engineering enthusiast who loves solving complex problems?

Join our Cloud Networking Products team!

Akamai Cloud is the world's most distributed cloud platform. Our customers range from frontier AI companies to scale-ups and established market leaders.We are looking for a new colleague to join our API team in the Cloud Networking Products division.

Partner with the best

Join us in shaping the next generation of cloud computing. This role provides an opportunity to make a significant impact on Akamai's growing cloud offerings. You must have a passion to get things done quickly and get them done right.

As a Software Engineer Senior, you will be responsible for:

Helping build out cloud platform functionality that sets up, manages, and protects networking in the Akamai Cloud.
Designing and implementing clean, robust and performant REST APIs used by customers and internal teams.
Developing and maintaining internal libraries and microservices used by various teams in Akamai.
Designing, implementing, reviewing, documenting, and testing high quality Python code in close collaboration with your team.
Reviewing and contributing to architectural and design documents authored by other teams.

Do What You Love

To be successful in this role you will:

Have background with mainstream programming languages, such as Python, Java, C#, or Go.
Have solid skills in writing, testing and understanding complex software.
Have experience in designing and implementing REST APIs.
Be experienced in technical design, product specifications reviews, projects and backlog planning.
Be able to work productively with team members to identify and resolve issues in a collaborative manner.
Have good communication skills, and experience in communicating with leadership and non-developer stakeholders.
Be experienced in mentoring other developers.

Some of the tools and frameworks we use are Python, docker, pytest, MySQL, SQLAlchemy, Flask, Prometheus and Grafana. While we don't expect you to have experience with all of them, curiosity and a willingness to learn is a must. Experience with developing microservices is a nice bonus. We are a team with a diverse background and while the majority of the team members are located in Denmark, our main working language is English.

About Us

At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.

Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.

Our Focus Is Simple

Cloud and Edge:
Running apps closer to users for instant performance.

Security
: Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.

Content Delivery
: Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.

AI
: Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.

At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.

Benefits at Akamai:
We support your health, well-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.

FlexBase adapts to your job's needs

Akamai's FlexBase program is yet another way we show our commitment to providing employees with an exceptional workplace experience. It's not about telling employees where to work; it's about supporting employees to do their best work.

We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both.

Connect with us on social and see what life at Akamai is like!

jobs.title: AI Workflow Engineer
jobs.description:
About us

We build the KeyShot, one of the leading 3D rendering products in the world, used across product design, engineering, marketing, and manufacturing to visualize and communicate ideas even before they're real. Used by companies like Google, Rolex, Louis Vuitton, HP, Microsoft, Philips, Adidas, and many more.

You'll be joining our cross functional web team, that builds the web services that expand KeyShot Studio for its users — powering collaboration, effective workflows, and the infrastructure that lets people work with renderings the way that suits them. We're growing this team to keep pushing that experience forward.

What you'll do

Design and set up AI workflows for implementing backend services in TypeScript, running on AWS
Retain high quality in an increasingly AI-driven development process - having strong review practices and keep tests quality.
Work within a microservice architecture, building services that are reliable and observable
Own your code through our CI/CD pipelines, and treat our test suite as a first-class part of the job
Build the services that give KeyShot users and collaborators smooth, reliable workflows - from SSO, integrations with Studio, Cloud Rendering to collaboration features
Collaborate closely with your team - reviewing code, finding solutions, share your insights and taking shared ownership of outcomes rather than working in solitude

What we're looking for

Experience designing and running AI-driven development workflows - using agentic coding tools (like Claude Code) to build and ship real production software
A track record of keeping quality high while working AI-first: reviewing, verifying, and course-correcting AI-generated code rather than accepting it at face value
Solid experience with TypeScript in a backend context
Experience with AWS cloud services and cloud architecture best practices (Infrastructure as Code like CDK, CloudFormation, or Terraform is a plus)
Comfort working in a microservice architecture - working with serverless and event-driven application design (Lambda, DynamoDB, or similar)
Experience with CI/CD and a genuine belief that a strong automated test suite is the foundation for moving quickly on top of a robust foundation
A collaborative, self-driven working style - we don't manage tightly, but we rely on people to bring initiative and support their teammates in equal measure
You're past needing close guidance on how to do the job, and you're looking for a team where your judgment is trusted
Professional working proficiency in English, written and spoken - our colleagues come from all over the world and English is our primary working language

What you'll join

You'll join a 8 person team of backend, frontend, and QA engineers, most based in our Aarhus Office, building the web services around KeyShot. We run flat and self-driven, valuing finding the solutions as a team. We back your development with real structure: biweekly 1:1s and an ongoing growth plan, so you keep developing.

Beyond the work, we offer health insurance, good maternity leave terms and a pension program as standard. On top of that: lunch scheme, massage, foosball, and regular social events.

Application and Interest

We are looking for candidates based in Aarhus, Odense, or Copenhagen. If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we'd love to hear from you! Got any questions? Feel free to reach out to Steffen Østerby Muldbjerg at steffen.muldbjerg@keyshot.com .

jobs.title: Delivery Engineer
jobs.description:
About Mixpanel

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com.

About The Delivery Engineer Team

As a member of the Delivery Engineer team, you will own the post-sales onboarding and data health for customers. Your goal will be to drive data trust, help embed Mixpanel into our customers’ data stack, and deliver on emerging AI integrations — delivering on the full value of Mixpanel as a self-serve analytics platform. You will work and consult with GTM team members and a diverse array of customers to successfully roll out product analytics to their organization and execute on technical projects and services that delight our customers.

About The Role

As a Delivery Engineer, you will be on the front lines with our clients as they integrate Mixpanel into their core product development processes. You will lay the foundation for customers to adopt product analytics and get value from Mixpanel by delivering a world-class, on-time, and value-oriented onboarding experience. With your comprehensive project management knowledge, consultative approach, expertise in the analytics space, and technical knowledge of the modern data stack, you will lead our clients' first experience with Mixpanel as they incorporate product analytics into their data ecosystem as a foundational element. With your deep technical breadth and expertise in the analytics space, you’ll be the expert consultant on all things data and ecosystem. As Mixpanel and our customers continue to iterate on agentic integrations, you’ll own ensuring customers are able to build, assemble context, and integrate AI workflows.

Responsibilities

Own onboarding and data health for our strategic and high-value clients, including ongoing enhancements to their data quality and overall tech stack integration
Align with pre-sales teams and consult with prospects/clients to define business goals and metrics to guide data architecture and project outcomes
Engage with customers’ engineering, product management, and marketing teams to handle technical onboarding, optimize Mixpanel deployments, and improve data trust
Deliver a variety of technical services ranging from data architecture consultations to adoption and change management best practices
Leverage modern data architecture expertise to create scalable data governance practices and data trust for our customers, including data optimization and re-implementation projects
Successfully execute on deliverables whilst balancing project timelines, scope creep, and unanticipated issues
Collaborate with our technical and solutions partners as needed on data optimization and onboarding projects
Be a technical sponsor for internal engagements with product and engineering teams to prioritize product and systems tasks from clients
Build AI automations to help customers manage their data at scale
Consult with customers on integrating their agentic workflows with Mixpanel data.

We're Looking For Someone Who Is

Comfortable with data querying, modeling, and transforming in at least one core tool, including SQL / dbt / Python / Business Intelligence tools / Product Analytics tools, etc.
Familiar with databases and cloud data warehouses like Google Cloud, Amazon Redshift, Microsoft Azure, etc.
Familiar with product analytics implementation methods like SDKs, Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), Event Streaming, Reverse ETL, etc.
Familiar with analytics best practices across business segments and verticals
Can manage complex projects with assorted client stakeholders, working across teams and departments to execute real change while managing scope and timelines
Has embedded AI into their workflows and is familiar with using MCP servers, building new skills, setting context, and can credibly consult with our customers about their AI/data strategy
Has experience in customer success, client-facing professional services, consulting, or technical project management role
Excellent written, analytical, and communication skills
Strong process and/or project delivery discipline
Eager to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving customer needs

Benefits And Perks

Comprehensive Medical, Vision, and Dental Care
Mental Wellness Benefit
Generous Vacation Policy & Additional Company Holidays
Enhanced Parental Leave
Volunteer Time Off
Additional US Benefits: Pre-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Break
please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary*

Culture Values

Make Bold Bets: We choose courageous action over comfortable progress.
Innovate with Insight: We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive powerful outcomes.
One Team: We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone.
Candor with Connection: We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations.
Champion the Customer: We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star.
Powerful Simplicity: We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible.

Why choose Mixpanel?

We’re a leader in analytics with over 29,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions.

Mixpanel is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. At Mixpanel, we are focused on things that really matter—our people, our customers, our partners—out of a recognition that those relationships are the most valuable assets we have. We actively encourage women, people with disabilities, veterans, underrepresented minorities, and LGBTQ+ people to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance or other similar laws that may be applicable, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We’ve immersed ourselves in our Culture and Values as our guiding principles for the impact we want to have and the future we are building.
